consent.title: Data handling consent
consent.intro: Before using ShuttleScope, please review the documents below and decide on the optional consents.
consent.other_docs_hint: Not required for consent — reference documents for specific use cases.
consent.ai_training_minor_notice: [For minors] This checkbox is unchecked by default. Please consult a legal guardian and tick it only if you explicitly intend to consent.
consent.scroll_hint: Open both 'View Privacy Notice' and 'View Terms of Service' above and scroll each document to the bottom. Once both are read, the mandatory checkboxes become enabled.
consent.required_hint: These are required for the service to operate (GDPR Art 6(1)(b) / APPI Art 18). Withdrawing is equivalent to ending service use.
consent.optional_section: Optional (you can use the service without checking these)
consent.optional_hint: Optional consents are based on GDPR Art 6(1)(a) / APPI consent. You can change them at any time from Settings → Condition → Body composition disclosure.
consent.service_delivery_label: I have reviewed the Privacy Notice and Terms of Service
consent.service_delivery_desc: The processing described in those documents (match data, player profile, analysis results, authentication, audit logging) is necessary to provide the service. Stopping the processing is equivalent to terminating service use.
consent.beta_agreement_label: I have reviewed the Beta data handling notice (Terms of Service Section 14)
consent.beta_agreement_desc: Beta-period data scope, purpose, retention, and third-party-sharing posture are described in TERMS §14. Objections during beta are accepted via the contact form per §14.5.
consent.ai_training_label: I consent to use of my data for AI model training
consent.ai_training_desc: Anonymized/aggregated data may be used to improve model accuracy. Optional and withdrawable at any time; withdrawal excludes future training. Withdrawal: contact form or contact@shuttle-scope.com.
consent.research_label: I consent to use of my data for academic research
consent.research_desc: Allows anonymized use for sports-science research and publications. Prior notice and right of withdrawal preserved. Withdrawal: contact form or contact@shuttle-scope.com.
consent.body_disclose_to_analyst_label: Share body-composition data with the analyst
consent.body_disclose_to_analyst_desc: Weight, body-fat %, muscle mass, etc. visible to your team analyst. Default is ON; toggle anytime in Settings → Condition → Body composition disclosure.
consent.body_disclose_to_coach_label: Share body-composition data with the coach
consent.body_disclose_to_coach_desc: Weight, body-fat %, muscle mass, etc. visible to your coach. Default is ON; toggle anytime in Settings → Condition → Body composition disclosure.
consent.withdraw_notice: Mandatory items cannot be withdrawn (withdrawal equals ending service use). Optional consents can be changed anytime via Settings → Condition → Body composition disclosure, or via the contact form / contact@shuttle-scope.com.

intro.title: Start here
intro.body: Mobile input is split into three small passes. You don't have to do everything at once — you can finish later on desktop.

passSwitch.title: Pass switch buttons
passSwitch.body: Tap the vertical buttons in the red box to switch between Pass 1 / 2 / 3. Start with whichever pass feels easiest.

pass1.title: Pass 1: Rally splits
pass1.body: Tap the video to pause, then press the big A or B scoring button. The score and serving side update automatically.

pass2.title: Pass 2: Serve & final shot
pass2.body: For each rally, add the serve position and the final shot type in 4 taps. That alone is enough for the analysis to work.

pass3.title: Pass 3: Stroke detail
pass3.body: Fill in every stroke of each rally. A 9-zone snap grid and a touch magnifier help you place coordinates accurately.

offline.title: Safe offline
offline.body: Everything is saved on your device (IndexedDB) and sent automatically when you're back online. Your input is never lost.

what.title: What is calibration?
what.body: Tap the 4 court corners and 2 net points to link the image to real court coordinates. The analysis accuracy depends on this.

loupe.title: A magnifier follows your finger
loupe.body: Your finger area is shown enlarged so you can line it up exactly with the court line intersections. Tap again to fix it.

retry.title: Redo any time
retry.body: You can reopen and adjust the calibration even after saving. The most recent saved value is always used.

welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.body: We'll walk through the main controls. The element glowing red is what we're talking about right now. Press Next to continue.

modeTabs.title: Mode tabs switch the workspace
modeTabs.body: The Input / Review / Analysis / Settings tabs in the red box change the right-side panel. Pick Input while you're annotating.

videoPane.title: Video player
videoPane.body: The red-boxed player lets you play, pause, and scrub. Pause exactly at the moment of contact before logging a shot. (Space to play/pause)

rallyPanel.title: Score panel
rallyPanel.body: Check the current score in the red box. When a rally ends, pick scorer and end type to confirm it. Score and serve side update automatically.

hitZone.title: Pick the hit zone
hitZone.body: Choose where on the court the shot was hit, using the 9 zones in the red box. If CV suggests one, just click to confirm.

shotTypes.title: Log the shot type
shotTypes.body: Use the buttons in the red box to record the shot type of the paused frame. Each button also has a keyboard shortcut (number keys).

historyStrip.title: Recent strokes
historyStrip.body: Click an item in the red-boxed history strip to seek the video to that moment. Handy for fixing a wrong entry quickly.

commandPalette.title: Ctrl+K finds anything
commandPalette.body: Press Ctrl+K (⌘K on Mac) anywhere to open the command palette: switch matches, find players, change settings — all from here. (Ctrl+K / ⌘K)

flow.title: The basic loop
flow.body: Play and pause the video, log scores and strokes, check in Review, then look at Analysis for patterns. Press Ctrl+K if you get lost.

analysis_reading._title: How to read the analysis screen

tabs.title: Switch via the top tabs
tabs.body: The red-boxed tabs switch between Overview / Live / Review / Growth / Detailed. Scroll horizontally to see the rest if needed.

confidence.title: Always check confidence
confidence.body: Each result shows a confidence badge and sample-size warning. When samples are small, focus on the trend, not the exact number.

epv.title: Reading EPV and win rate
epv.body: EPV is the expected point value of a rally. Win rate is estimated from the current score situation, not the whole match.

growth.title: Players see growth, not weakness
growth.body: Player-facing screens use "growth areas" instead of "weakness". Raw EPV and win rates are never shown to the player role.

where.title: This is the disclosure setting
where.body: From the red-boxed "Body composition disclosure" you can turn sharing with analysts/coaches on or off. It starts at whatever you chose in the consent popup.

revoke.title: You can revoke any time
revoke.body: Turning it off takes effect immediately. That role can no longer see raw values (only the 3-tier overall rating).

impact.title: What happens if you don't disclose
impact.body: Annotation features still work as normal. You just lose the body-composition correlations in coaching and analysis views.
